name: Harford County, MD
findings: Harford County has 754 nonprofit organizations. 336 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 271 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Harford County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 58 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 arts and cultural organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.
